There is a movement in the natural and social sciences to increase the reliability and reproducibility of peer-reviewed research. One of the main endeavours in this initiative is to make data and code publicly available for replication and scrutiny.

find_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  dir <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = FALSE)
  while (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "_quarto.yml"))) {
    parent <- dirname(dir)
    if (identical(parent, dir)) stop("Could not locate _quarto.yml")
    dir <- parent
  }
  dir
}
source(file.path(find_root(), "R_scripts", "project_listings.R"))
render_project_pubs(c("Open science", "reproducibility"))
